name: The Florist
source:
You are a florist in a small town. Now that Spring is here, there's plenty of flowers to care for and orders to fill. Check up on your friends and neighbors and get them the flowers they need.

[From [url=https://skylilywolf.itch.io/the-florist]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是小镇上的一名花店店主。春天到了，有许多鲜花等待照料，也有许多订单需要完成。去看看朋友与邻居，为他们送上需要的花吧。

[摘自[url=https://skylilywolf.itch.io/the-florist]itch.io[/url]]
